brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates exemplary clinical management with all six responsibility-chain requirements fully met and four high-order points completed. The doctor proactively queried workspace records, delivered structured medication guidance, achieved family teach-back on emergency criteria, and maintained correct prioritization throughout. No responsibility-chain errors or important non-chain defects exist.
